name: Native Grapple baseline
description: The native starting procedure preserves the two-stage D&D 3.x Grapple concept, distinct from the modern 5e Athletics/Acrobatics or saving-throw initiation.

steps.name: Initiate touch
steps.rule: Make a qualifying melee touch attack against the target's Touch AC; apply the eventually defined native attack cost and opportunity policy.

steps.name: Establish hold
steps.rule: On successful contact, resolve an opposed grapple check involving combat ability, Strength and applicable size modifiers; contact alone is not a Grapple.

steps.name: Escape by force
steps.rule: Use an opposed grapple check against the grappler, respecting native attack-substitution timing when specified.

steps.name: Escape by technique
steps.rule: Use a Dexterity-based Escape Artist check opposed by the holder's grapple check; armor check penalties can apply under the source comparison.

sourceIllustration: Historical 3.5 grapple check uses BAB + Strength modifier + special grapple size modifier; this is not a completed blanket native attack-economy translation.
notEquivalentTo: Automatic application of every 3.5e opportunity or move-action cost
unresolved: Exact attack cost, opportunity triggers, native timing, occupied-space interactions, casting constraints, multiple grapplers and feature-specific bypasses.
